function.description: List the pools a public indexer currently ranks as TRENDING on a chain. Trending is a popularity claim and popularity is purchasable, so treat this as a place to look, never a verdict. Screen every candidate with token_info before acting on it.
function.name: defi_data_trending

chain.description: Chain to discover pools on — the same address is a DIFFERENT token on a different chain, so name it deliberately. Readable: ethereum, base, robinhood, robinhood-testnet, arbitrum, polygon, optimism, solana.

min_liquidity_usd.description: Exclude pools whose reported liquidity is BELOW this. A pool whose liquidity is UNKNOWN is never excluded by this floor — unknown is not a number, and dropping it would hide it from you silently.

min_volume_h24_usd.description: Exclude pools whose 24h volume is below this. Same unknown rule.
